input.quote: 13.4 Limitation of Liability. Notwithstanding any provision in this Agreement, M&I's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed payments made to M&I by Customer under this Agreement during the three (3) months prior to the event.
input.rationale: Section 13.4 caps only M&I's liability, leaving Customer uncapped, at three months' payments and with no carve-outs — this hits two walk-away triggers (one-sided cap and a Vendor cap below six months' fees) and indemnities under Section 14.2 sit inside the cap with no super-cap. We therefore edited the single capping sentence to the fallback: a mutual cap at twelve months' payments made to M&I, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct uncapped. The mutual exclusion of indirect and consequential damages in Section 13.2 is retained; preferred extras (greater-of USD 1,000,000, data protection/security, fraud and IP carve-outs, payment-obligation exclusion) are not pursued at this level.

mappings.element: The aggregate liability cap applies mutually to both parties.
The cap is based on 12 months of fees.
Breach of confidentiality obligations is uncapped.

proposal.summary: Make the Section 13.4 cap mutual, set it at twelve months' payments, and carve out indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We made the Section 13.4 cap mutual and aligned it to twelve months' payments (our fallback position; three months is below our walk-away floor), and carved out indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and willful misconduct so those claims sit outside the cap.

ops.oldText: Notwithstanding any provision in this Agreement, M&I's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed payments made to M&I by Customer under this Agreement during the three (3) months prior to the event.
ops.newText: Except for indemnification obligations, breach of confidentiality obligations, gross negligence and willful misconduct, which are uncapped, each party's total liability under this Agreement shall not exceed payments made to M&I by Customer under this Agreement during the twelve (12) months prior to the event.
